title: The power of poetry
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can a short poem sometimes express an idea more powerfully than a long explanation?
Do you need to fully understand a poem to enjoy it?
Which is more important in poetry: the meaning, the sound, or the emotion? Why?
Have you ever remembered a line from a poem, song, or quote for years? What made it stay with you?
Would poetry become more popular if it were taught differently at school?
